sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 180. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 50 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Recovers 30 Cost.
Only [Acquisitive] Queen of Hearts can be used as Unlocking Potential material
